$comment: Capability-owned routing cases. A null expectedTool means no Git Optimizer tool should run.

cases.request: Compare this pull request branch to main and tell me which files changed before I inspect source.
cases.reason: A bounded commit comparison should precede AST or raw-source reads.

cases.request: Did the deployment template change between these two local commits?
cases.reason: A complete changed-file inventory can establish whether a tracked path changed.

cases.request: Which source declarations changed on this branch so I can select files for AST analysis?
cases.reason: Git orientation should select the smallest useful AST follow-up.

cases.request: Show and stage my uncommitted working-tree changes.
cases.reason: The capability compares commits and never mutates a working tree.

cases.request: Return the exact full patch and every changed source line.
cases.reason: The capability returns bounded orientation, not a full patch.

cases.request: Clone this repository, fetch the pull request, and push a fix.
cases.reason: The capability never performs network or mutating Git operations.
